steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Dash+ USB-C charging port

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the charging port on the bottom.
Give it a full charge before first use — takes about **1 hour**.
The LED blinks **8 times** when the battery is low.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Loading the G Pen Dash+ herb chamber

bullets.text: Remove the **mouthpiece** by pulling it straight up.
Fill the **titanium chamber** with finely ground dry herb — don't pack it tight.
Replace the mouthpiece before powering on.

note.text: **~0.3g capacity.** A fine, even grind gives the best vapor and airflow through the spiral ceramic airpath.

steps.title: Set & Heat
steps.imageAlt: Setting temperature on the G Pen Dash+

bullets.text: **Hold the power button for 3 seconds** to turn on. The display lights up.
Press **+ / −** to adjust your target temperature.
**Double-click** to start a session. The device vibrates when it reaches temp (~20 sec).
The session auto-ends when the countdown hits 0:00. Device goes to standby.

press.sub: Hold the power button for 3 seconds

steps.title: Draw
steps.imageAlt: Drawing from the G Pen Dash+

bullets.text: Once the device vibrates, **draw slowly and steadily** through the mouthpiece.
The spiral ceramic airpath cools vapor before it reaches you.
Device powers off automatically after **1 minute** of no activity.

note.text: **After your session:** Let the device cool, then remove the mouthpiece and brush out the chamber. Regular cleaning keeps flavor and airflow at their best.

faq.question: Device won't turn on
faq.answer: Hold the power button for a full 3 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device — the battery may be depleted. The LED display lights up when it's on.

faq.question: How do I know it's ready to use?
faq.answer: After you double-click to start a session, the device vibrates once when it reaches your set temperature. The session countdown then begins on the display.

faq.question: Vapor is thin or tastes off
faq.answer: Try a finer grind and make sure the chamber isn't overpacked. Clean the mouthpiece and airpath regularly — residue buildup is the most common cause of reduced vapor and off flavor.

faq.question: What do the error codes mean?
faq.answer: If the display shows an error, power the device off and back on. If the error persists after charging and restarting, contact G Pen support for a warranty assessment.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Dash+ includes a 2-year limited warranty covering electronics and manufacturing defects. Register your device at gpen.com to extend it to 3 years. Physical damage is not covered.
